_comment: Manifest for the 7 data/test_pdfs/ document-agent test cases, mirroring README.md's table. Consumed by api/routes_evals.py's /cases and /cases/{id}/materialize endpoints to pre-fill SubmitClaim.jsx's form and pre-stage the case's PDF(s) via the real upload endpoints. All cases share one baseline claim (baseline_claim.json, policy POL-AUTO-TEST-US - a real seeded policy, no seeding needed).

claim.incident_description: Two-vehicle collision at intersection. Other driver ran red light and struck my vehicle. Took it to a repair shop for an estimate.

cases.label: Clean baseline
cases.description: All 3 documents extract cleanly, no verification findings.

cases.label: Scanned repair estimate (OCR fallback)
cases.description: Image-only PDF, no text layer - tests Docling's OCR fallback path.

cases.label: Arithmetic mismatch
cases.description: Line items sum to $23,100 but the printed total says $28,500 - tests the line_items_sum vs stated_total check.

cases.label: Wrong document in wrong slot
cases.description: A repair estimate uploaded into the police_report slot - tests classify-then-extract mismatch detection.

cases.label: Corrupt / unreadable file
cases.description: Not a valid PDF - tests the Docling-throws fallback, no crash.

cases.label: Plausibility mismatch
cases.description: Internally consistent $85,000 repair estimate, wildly higher than the claim's own $23,100 estimated_amount.

cases.label: Legitimately sparse (lump-sum)
cases.description: No itemized line items, just a lump-sum total - must NOT be flagged as a verification failure.
